facts.fact: Porky 这个绰号是血肉世界里别的孩子给他的，重复得多到他自己也这么称呼自己
facts.anchor: “Porky” is the name other children gave him in Flesh

facts.fact: 在梦里 Porky 一样胖，但轻到能飞，下面是一片夜海
facts.anchor: In Dream, Porky is no less fat, but much lighter, light enough to fly.

facts.fact: Porky 在夜海里看见一个全裸同龄女孩在游泳，他想下去陪游但没有勇气
facts.anchor: There’s a girl swimming in the water, completely naked.

facts.fact: Filippo 有口吃，讨厌 s 太多的词；梦里他不再当众背诵课文，而是在森林里
facts.anchor: Filippo has a stammer and he hates words with too many s’s

facts.fact: 叙述者判定：父母已经放弃 wonder 住进 world，所以永远不懂孩子们为什么越挨打越开心
facts.anchor: Their parents can never understand, because they’ve had their time, and given up on wonder to live in the world.

facts.fact: Santa Lucia 疗养诊所由 19 世纪的 occultist Girolamo Venturi 创立，相信科学与信仰两条路；Wedge 虽是街头孩子，父亲的钱把他送进这里
facts.anchor: it was founded in the 19th century by Girolamo Venturi, the famous, wealthy, and pious occultist

facts.fact: 前一天傍晚 Augusto Dal Mare 打电话给 Luca 的父亲要求见儿子，说发生的事令人发指、要让有人付出代价
facts.anchor: Yesterday evening, Augusto Dal Mare called Luca’s father to ask to meet his son.

facts.fact: Dal Mare 十四年来因伤微跛，拄一根带弯银柄的木手杖；护士背后叫他 Dr. House
facts.anchor: Dal Mare enters the clinic limping slightly, as injury has forced him to do for the last fourteen years

facts.fact: Luca 父母过度打扮迎接记者，假装心碎，实际高兴得儿子死在哪儿都无所谓
facts.anchor: They pose as brokenhearted parents, even though it’s obvious they’re so pleased to see him

facts.fact: Dal Mare 要求单独和 Luca 待着，父母离开，门咔一声关上
facts.anchor: Then he realises that the man has asked to be left alone with him

facts.fact: Dal Mare 说你的朋友没你这么坚强，即 PsyKlops/Giulio 伤得更重
facts.anchor: “Unfortunately your friend wasn’t so much,” he adds.

facts.fact: Dal Mare 追问那条口信，Wedge 复述：告诉他们他回来了；Dal Mare 说这些就是原话吗、他会去打听
Wedge 想起袭击者是赤脚的；Dal Mare  sharply 抬头强调报纸没提这点、而且那是在柏油路上
facts.anchor: Wedge thinks for a moment. “Their feet were bare,” he remembers.

facts.fact: Dal Mare 认定 Wedge 隐瞒了去年夏天做的事，起身离开时丢下「别再对我撒谎」；他出门时没有看这个致残的男孩
facts.anchor: “Never lie to me again,” he warns, before walking out.

facts.fact: Luca 把恐惧归因于止痛药；但当 Dal Mare 发怒时，手杖银柄看起来变了形：arched, curved, pointed，almost like a hook
facts.anchor: It has to be the drugs. It’s their fault if the man’s voice changed

facts.fact: Wondrous Wendy（真名 Angela）在 Via Veneto 等中等经纪人 Aldo Miglio，约十一点，他十二点才出来；她在魔法道具店 The Magic Hat 打工，为这次见面求了半天假
facts.anchor: Wendy has an appointment with Aldo at eleven

facts.fact: Aldo 给的活是周日一场派对：朋友女儿的十八岁生日，但不付钱，说是他送给女孩的礼物
facts.anchor: His daughter’s eighteenth. He was looking for something special

facts.fact: Aldo 判定 magic 不再卖座，要她把怪物改成南方穷人做社会评论、并删掉 illusionism 部分，理由是 Houdini 时代已经结束
facts.anchor: A seven-year-old can make a video a thousand times more spectacular

facts.fact: 每次见 Aldo，Wendy 的自信都从脚下塌掉；她要的不是出名，而是做出最好的魔术；本章末她让步说「我们谈谈周日的事」
facts.anchor: Seeing Aldo always makes her confidence collapse from beneath her feet.
